taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Secret Manager version access and conditional IAM scope
controls.source_trace: Separate metadata, secret-version access and permission to change IAM/version state. Evaluate the actual resource/condition context used by the workload.
controls.implementation_branch: Resolve the full project/secret/version and any alias at access time. Metadata/list permissions and secret-version payload access differ. An alias such as latest can change during rotation; compare the authorized resource and actual selected version, including conditional IAM context, rather than assuming permission on one version generalizes to all secret data.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned secret with a synthetic value and compare intended principal/version with a restricted owned principal.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A secret name or version listing is not access to secret bytes; a missing version is not authorization evidence.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain access and delegation to intended secrets/versions and retest permitted rotation workflows.
